expectationReview.firstVideoReason: The first head-template video visibly includes Face 16 after Face 12, so it cannot be described as covering only Face 1 through Face 12.
expectationReview.secondVideoReason: The second head-template video visibly includes Face 30 and Face 31 before ending on Face 29. Face 29 is not proven to be the final available head.
expectationReview.face12OverlapReason: Face 12 is selected near the end of video 002 and again at the beginning of video 003. It is one catalog identity with multiple evidence observations, not two records.

ambiguousEntries: Video 002 contains Face 16 despite the previous working-name expectation of Face 1 through Face 12.
